scope: Model/editor review after repairing the weekday word model while keeping the first weekday response intentionally bounded; not an independent human or learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: What day? / On Monday. is a natural short schedule exchange when the program is already established, and Monday? / Yes. works as a brief confirmation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian instructions distinguish the day meaning from time and room information and explain on only in its bounded weekday use.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: on and Monday are independent target words, while the Lesson explicitly limits practice to the fixed On Monday response and defers productive On + weekday generalization until a second weekday exists.

distractorQuality.evidence: Reading and response choices contrast day, time and room meanings without relying on formatting tricks.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Leo and Liam are coordinating the already-established library event, so the elliptical day question is locally motivated.

difficultyFit.evidence: Only Monday and the bounded day use of on are introduced; the Lesson does not force a second weekday merely to satisfy a generativity rule.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Monday is taught independently, read on a program card, heard in dialogue and retrieved inside the short response.

transferQuality.evidence: The schedule-question idea transfers from clock time to weekday while the response remains appropriately bounded until another weekday is taught.

overallCoherence.evidence: Word teaching, card reading, dialogue, selection and final retrieval all serve understanding and stating the Monday program day without overclaiming a general weekday construction.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static review only; the flow is short and clear, but real learner timing, speech recognition and delayed weekday retention remain untested.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The Lesson establishes only Monday and one bounded response, not a productive weekday inventory.
Final ElevenLabs prosody and delayed retention remain unmeasured.
resolvedFindings: Monday is now an independent word rather than existing only inside On Monday.
on is separately represented in the word layer for this taught use.
The Lesson does not prematurely declare On + weekday productive; that generativity requirement starts when a second weekday is introduced.
On Monday remains compositional lesson text and is not inserted as a fake vocabulary row.
